caption: The drawing features a single object: a lantern. The lantern has a rectangular, vertical body with clear glass panels on its sides, encased in a metal frame. The metal frame is colored in various shades of brown and has horizontal and vertical bars for structural support, giving it a grid-like appearance. The top of the lantern is a brown, pyramid-shaped metal roof with two small circular holes on each triangular face. Attached to the peak of the roof is a circular, brown metal ring, likely serving as a handle or suspension loop. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or light beige color with some sporadic brownish spots scattered around. There are no other objects or background elements present in the drawing.
title: Lantern
